title: Seed.locale: no fallback set — an organization whose language is outside every declared set gets none of a locale-split seed (e.g. no standard price book)
body:
## What (18.5.0)

An app splits a seed by language with `Seed.locale`, for example a zh-CN set (「标准价格表」) and an en/en-US set ("Standard"). An organization whose language matches none of the declared sets (ja-JP, es-ES) receives **neither**. Where the seed is functional rather than decorative, such as the standard price book that quotes fall back to, that organization ends up without it.

## Ask

A declared fallback: either one set marked `locale: '*'` or `fallback: true`, used when no other set matches, or a rule such as "the set matching the app's default locale is the fallback". The app could also leave one set unscoped, but then that set is loaded in addition to the matching one, which duplicates functional rows.
